017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20260728;
018
019import org.apache.juneau.commons.concurrent.*;
020
021/**
022 * Binding-owned MRTR (Multi-Round-Trip Request) configuration for a v2 {@link McpRevision}.
023 *
024 * <p>
025 * Mirrors {@link McpCacheConfig}'s exact placement precedent (spec Open item #2): MRTR is as
026 * {@code 2026-07-28}-only as cache hints, so its configuration lives here, on the v2 adapter, never on the
027 * revision-neutral {@link org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.McpServerConfig}.
028 *
029 * <p>
030 * <b>Mutable during setup, effectively immutable once published.</b> This is a builder-less mutable-setup
031 * bean: its fluent setters exist to configure it during construction, but a binding must fully configure it
032 * <i>before</i> handing it to a {@link McpRevision} and must never mutate it afterward. The dispatcher reads
033 * the codec/TTL/max-rounds on every request with no synchronization, so a post-publication mutation is a data
034 * race; treat a published instance as read-only.
035 *
036 * <p>
037 * Defaults: {@link AeadRequestStateCodec} (a fresh instance per {@link McpMrtrConfig}), a 5-minute
038 * {@code requestState} TTL, a max-rounds cap of 10, and no {@link ReplayCache} (replay rejection is opt-in; see
039 * {@link #setReplayCache(ReplayCache)}). Operators inject a shared/rotating-key {@link RequestStateCodec} here
040 * for multi-instance or restart-durable resumption.
041 *
042 * <h5 class='section'>Trust model:</h5>
043 * <ul>
044 *    <li><b>{@code requestState} is a bearer token.</b> Anyone holding a sealed {@code requestState} can resume
045 *       the paused operation until it expires; the token is not bound to a caller identity. It must be
046 *       transported only over authenticated TLS and <b>never logged</b> (it is opaque ciphertext, but logging
047 *       it hands a replayable credential to anyone with log access). See {@link RequestStateCodec}.
048 *    <li><b>Resume side effects must be idempotent by default.</b> A captured token can be replayed any number
049 *       of times within its {@link #getTtlMs() TTL} <i>unless</i> a {@link ReplayCache} is configured (see
050 *       {@link #setReplayCache(ReplayCache)}) to enforce single-use &mdash; the built-in
051 *       {@link InMemoryReplayCache} is per-process only, so cross-node single-use requires a shared
052 *       implementation. The {@link #getMaxRounds() max-rounds cap} bounds the <i>depth</i> of a single resume
053 *       chain, not the total number of times a given token can be re-submitted, so a handler must not treat a
054 *       resume as a once-only event unless it knows single-use is enforced.
055 * </ul>
056 */
057public class McpMrtrConfig {
058
059   /** Default {@code requestState} TTL in milliseconds: 5 minutes. */
060   public static final long DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000L;
061
062   /** Default max-rounds cap. */
063   public static final int DEFAULT_MAX_ROUNDS = 10;
064
065   private RequestStateCodec codec = new AeadRequestStateCodec();
066   private long ttlMs = DEFAULT_TTL_MS;
067   private int maxRounds = DEFAULT_MAX_ROUNDS;
068   private ReplayCache replayCache;
069
070   /**
071    * The codec used to seal/unseal {@code requestState} tokens.
072    *
073    * @return The codec. Never {@code null}.
074    */
075   public RequestStateCodec getCodec() {
076      return codec;
077   }
078
079   /**
080    * Sets the codec.
081    *
082    * @param value The new value. Must not be {@code null}.
083    * @return This object.
084    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code value} is {@code null}.
085    */
086   public McpMrtrConfig setCodec(RequestStateCodec value) {
087      if (value == null)
088         throw new IllegalArgumentException("codec must not be null");
089      codec = value;
090      return this;
091   }
092
093   /**
094    * Sets the key provider, wrapping it in a fresh {@link AeadRequestStateCodec}.
095    *
096    * <p>
097    * Sugar for the common "keep AES-GCM, just supply my keys" case &mdash; equivalent to
098    * {@code setCodec(new AeadRequestStateCodec(value))}. {@link #setKeyProvider} and {@link #setCodec} are
099    * last-wins: both assign the same {@code codec} field, so whichever is called more recently determines the
100    * effective codec. There is no getter for the provider itself &mdash; {@link #getCodec()} remains the sole
101    * accessor, since the codec (not the provider) is the source of truth once either setter has been called.
102    *
103    * @param value The new value. Must not be {@code null}.
104    * @return This object.
105    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code value} is {@code null}.
106    */
107   public McpMrtrConfig setKeyProvider(KeyProvider value) {
108      if (value == null)
109         throw new IllegalArgumentException("keyProvider must not be null");
110      return setCodec(new AeadRequestStateCodec(value));
111   }
112
113   /**
114    * The {@code requestState} time-to-live in milliseconds.
115    *
116    * @return The TTL. Always {@code > 0}.
117    */
118   public long getTtlMs() {
119      return ttlMs;
120   }
121
122   /**
123    * Sets the TTL.
124    *
125    * @param value The new value. Must be {@code > 0}.
126    * @return This object.
127    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code value} is not {@code > 0}.
128    */
129   public McpMrtrConfig setTtlMs(long value) {
130      if (value <= 0)
131         throw new IllegalArgumentException("ttlMs " + value + " must be > 0");
132      ttlMs = value;
133      return this;
134   }
135
136   /**
137    * The max-rounds cap.
138    *
139    * <p>
140    * Counts total handler invocations in a single resume chain, not just the resumes: the default of 10 permits
141    * 1 initial call plus 9 resumes before {@link McpRevision#CODE_MAX_ROUNDS_EXCEEDED} is returned.
142    *
143    * @return The cap. Always {@code >= 1}.
144    */
145   public int getMaxRounds() {
146      return maxRounds;
147   }
148
149   /**
150    * Sets the max-rounds cap.
151    *
152    * @param value The new value. Must be {@code >= 1}.
153    * @return This object.
154    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code value} is not {@code >= 1}.
155    */
156   public McpMrtrConfig setMaxRounds(int value) {
157      if (value < 1)
158         throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxRounds " + value + " must be >= 1");
159      maxRounds = value;
160      return this;
161   }
162
163   /**
164    * The {@link ReplayCache} used to reject reuse of a consumed {@code requestState} token, or <jk>null</jk> if
165    * none is configured.
166    *
167    * <p>
168    * <b>Unset (<jk>null</jk>) by default &mdash; replay rejection is opt-in.</b> A dispatcher only performs a
169    * replay check when this returns non-<jk>null</jk> (see {@code McpRevision#resolveMrtrContext}); with no
170    * {@link ReplayCache} configured, a {@code requestState} token remains multi-use within its TTL, exactly as
171    * documented on {@link RequestStateCodec}.
172    *
173    * @return The configured replay cache, or <jk>null</jk> if replay rejection is disabled (the default).
174    */
175   public ReplayCache getReplayCache() {
176      return replayCache;
177   }
178
179   /**
180    * Sets the replay cache, enabling replay rejection.
181    *
182    * <p>
183    * Passing <jk>null</jk> is allowed and explicitly reverts to the default, opt-out behavior (no replay check;
184    * a token stays multi-use within its TTL) &mdash; unlike {@link #setCodec(RequestStateCodec)}, there is no
185    * always-non-null invariant to preserve here, since "no replay cache" is itself the documented default.
186    *
187    * @param value The replay cache to use, or <jk>null</jk> to disable replay rejection.
188    * @return This object.
189    */
190   public McpMrtrConfig setReplayCache(ReplayCache value) {
191      replayCache = value;
192      return this;
193   }
194}
